scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:workers: concurrently -n outbox,autonomous,sandbox,k8smon -c yellow,cyan,green,red "npm run worker:outbox" "npm run worker:autonomous" "npm run worker:sandbox" "npm run worker:kubernetes-monitor"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:frontend: npm --prefix client-ui run lint && npm --prefix client-ui run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix client-ui run lint && .venv/bin/python -m compileall agent-platform shared
scripts.lint:backend: .venv/bin/python -m ruff check agent-platform/api agent-platform/models agent-platform/services agent-platform/workers shared
scripts.typecheck:backend: MYPYPATH=agent-platform:. .venv/bin/python -m mypy --namespace-packages --explicit-package-bases --disable-error-code import-untyped agent-platform/api/core/config.py agent-platform/api/core/security.py agent-platform/api/db/postgres.py agent-platform/models/control_plane.py shared/types/telemetry.py
scripts.ci:backend: npm run lint:backend && npm run typecheck:backend && npm run test:backend:coverage
scripts.ci:frontend: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.ci:all: npm run ci:backend && npm run ci:frontend && npm run test:sdk
